matters.title: Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025
matters.issue: Constitutional validity of the 2025 amendments to the Waqf Act; parts stayed by interim order of 15 Sep 2025.
matters.parties: In re: The Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025

last_hearing.outcome: Petitioners flagged changes in the status of waqf properties; Court will hear the challenge, including pleas for further interim relief, on 4 Nov.

matters.title: Delhi protests against the CEC and SIR
matters.issue: Pleas on detentions, Metro shutdown and police action during protests against CEC Gyanesh Kumar; contempt of the 11 Oct order.
matters.parties: M A Baby v Union of India; Shailendra Mani Tripathi v Govind Mohan

last_hearing.outcome: Challenge to s.163 BNSS itself not entertained; notice on s.172 BNSS (returnable 19 Nov); Delhi Police to file the s.163 orders and preserve CCTV footage.

matters.note: Also: 5 Nov — women journalists' harassment plea; 19 Nov — s.172 BNSS and the s.163 prohibitory orders.

matters.title: Delhi Special Intensive Revision (SIR)
matters.issue: Challenge to the SIR of Delhi's electoral rolls; deleted voters being asked to file Form 6.
matters.parties: Anjali Bhardwaj v Election Commission of India

last_hearing.outcome: Hearing advanced from 30 Oct to 28 Oct.

matters.title: SIR — Rahul Gandhi & INDIA bloc leaders' petition
matters.issue: Suspension of the SIR across States, an audit of voter deletions by a committee under a retired SC judge, and whether the CEC can act without the other Election Commissioners.
matters.parties: Rahul Gandhi & Ors. v Election Commission of India & Ors.

last_hearing.outcome: Notice issued to the ECI, the CEC and the Election Commissioners; SIR petitions to be heard together on 27 Oct.

matters.title: Duration of the five-year law degree
matters.issue: PIL asking whether the five-year integrated LL.B. should be cut to four years.
matters.parties: Ashwini Kumar Upadhyay v Union of India

matters.title: Asaram — appeal against conviction (2013 Jodhpur rape case)
matters.issue: Challenge to conviction and life sentence.
matters.parties: Asha Ram @ Ashumal v State of Rajasthan
matters.date_text: 6 Nov, 2 PM per LawBeat; the order (LiveLaw) says only "Post this matter in November"

last_hearing.outcome: "Post this matter in November."

matters.title: SHANTI Act, 2025 — nuclear liability
matters.issue: Caps on operator liability and exemption of suppliers under the Act that replaced the Civil Liability for Nuclear Damage Act, 2010.
matters.parties: EAS Sarma v Union of India
matters.date_text: Was listed 14 Oct 2026; next date not yet reported

last_hearing.outcome: Outcome not yet reported.

matters.note: Outcome of 14 Oct hearing not yet reported

matters.title: Marital rape exception
matters.issue: Validity of Exception 2 to s.375 IPC / s.63 BNS, which excludes forced sex by a husband from rape.
matters.parties: RIT Foundation v Union of India and connected matters
matters.date_text: Final hearing directed on Wednesdays/Thursdays; start date not yet confirmed

last_hearing.outcome: Directed listing for final hearing within three weeks.

matters.title: Election Commissioners' appointment law (2023 Act)
matters.issue: Whether dropping the CJI from the selection panel for the CEC and ECs is valid; referred to a Constitution Bench.
matters.parties: Dr. Jaya Thakur v Union of India
matters.date_text: Awaiting constitution of the Bench

last_hearing.outcome: Split order (Datta J / S.C. Sharma J); papers placed before the CJI for a Constitution Bench. 2026 INSC 1040.

matters.title: Lifelong immunity for the CEC and ECs
matters.issue: Validity of s.16 of the CEC Act, 2023, which protects the CEC and ECs from proceedings for official acts.
matters.parties: Association for Democratic Reforms v Union of India
match_parties: ASSOCIATION FOR DEMOCRATIC REFORMS.*\|.*UNION OF INDIA
matters.date_text: Notice issued 13 Oct 2026; next date not reported

last_hearing.outcome: Notice issued to the Union and the ECI.

matters.title: Places of Worship Act, 1991
matters.issue: Challenge to the law freezing the religious character of places of worship as on 15 Aug 1947; surveys and new suits barred meanwhile.
matters.parties: Ashwini Kumar Upadhyay v Union of India and connected matters
matters.date_text: Final-hearing date to be fixed

last_hearing.outcome: Court said it would fix a date for final hearing.

matters.title: Tenure of the BCI Chairperson
matters.issue: Challenge to the long tenure of the Bar Council of India Chairperson; elections to State Bar Councils and the BCI.
matters.parties: Yogamaya M.G. v Union of India
matters.date_text: Next date not reported

last_hearing.outcome: Chairperson to continue pro tem until fresh elections; elections to be expedited.

matters.title: De-notification of Jantar Mantar as a protest site
matters.issue: Challenge to the 11 Oct order moving protests away from Jantar Mantar (Art. 19(1)(a) and (b)).
matters.parties: Swaty Singh v Union of India & Anr.

last_hearing.outcome: Notice issued; Centre to reply. Court asked whether the de-notification relied on its own oral observations; SG said the Court's judgment was not the basis.

matters.note: Heard with the Delhi protest batch on 3 Nov.

matters.title: Definition of the Aravalli Hills
matters.issue: Expert committee on what counts as the Aravalli hills and ranges; stay on mining continues.
matters.parties: In re: Definition of Aravalli Hills and Ranges

last_hearing.outcome: Six-month extension refused; committee report due 30 Nov 2026 (non-extendable).

matters.title: Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Amendment Act, 2026
matters.issue: Constitutional validity of the 2026 amendments; High Court proceedings stayed and referred to a three-judge Bench.
matters.parties: Batch of writ petitions v Union of India
matters.date_text: Before a three-judge Bench; next date not found

last_hearing.outcome: Notice issued; no stay; referred to a three-judge Bench.

matters.note: Case number and lead petitioner not yet confirmed.

matters.title: Citizenship Amendment Act, 2019
matters.issue: Validity of the CAA and the 2024 Rules (about 240 petitions, with separate Assam and Tripura slots).
matters.parties: Indian Union Muslim League v Union of India
matters.date_text: Final hearing was fixed for 5–12 May 2026; current status to be verified

matters.title: Sabarimala reference (essential religious practices)
matters.issue: Nine-judge reference on the scope of religious freedom and essential religious practices.
matters.parties: Kantaru Rajeevaru v Indian Young Lawyers Association (reference)
matters.date_text: Judgment reserved on 14 May 2026

last_hearing.outcome: Judgment reserved after 16 days of arguments.

matters.title: States' power to tax annual turnover
matters.issue: Seven-judge reference on additional tax on dealers' sales turnover.
matters.parties: Arjun Flour Mills v State of Orissa
matters.date_text: Judgment reserved on 22 Sep 2026

last_hearing.outcome: Heard in one day; judgment reserved.

matters.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
matters.issue: Validity of the DPDP Act and Rules, including the dilution of the RTI Act (s.44(3)) and government access to data (s.36).
matters.parties: The Reporters' Collective v Union of India; NCPRI v Union of India and connected
matters.date_text: Referred to a larger Bench; next date not reported

last_hearing.outcome: Notice issued; no stay of the Act; RTI-amendment pleas referred to a larger Bench.

matters.title: Vande Mataram six-stanza mandate
matters.issue: Challenge to the directive mandating all six stanzas of Vande Mataram, as violating secularism.
matters.parties: Bhimrao Duryodhan Borkar v Union of India
matters.date_text: Filed; not yet listed

matters.title: Census 2027 — caste by self-declaration
matters.issue: Whether caste can be recorded in the 2027 Census on self-declaration alone, without verifying caste certificates.
matters.parties: Petition on caste data collection in Census 2027
matters.date_text: Next date not reported

last_hearing.outcome: Union asked to place on record the SOP for collecting and verifying caste data; no notice issued yet.

matters.title: Children's use of social media
matters.issue: Whether the Centre should frame rules under the IT Act to regulate children's access to social media.
matters.parties: Just Rights for Children Alliance v Union of India
matters.date_text: Next date not reported

last_hearing.outcome: Centre asked to frame rules; Court may issue directions under the IT Act.

matters.title: Sohrabuddin Shaikh encounter — appeal against acquittal
matters.issue: Appeal against the acquittal of 22 accused in the Sohrabuddin Shaikh encounter case; 92 witnesses turned hostile.
matters.parties: Rubabuddin Shaikh v Central Bureau of Investigation
matters.date_text: Notice issued; next date not reported

last_hearing.outcome: Notice issued on the appeal.

matters.title: 2008 Ahmedabad serial blasts — death sentences
matters.issue: Appeals by convicts sentenced to death for the 2008 Ahmedabad serial blasts.
matters.parties: Ahmed Bawa v State of Gujarat and connected
matters.date_text: Appeal pending; next date not reported

last_hearing.outcome: Execution of death sentence stayed.

matters.title: Rape incidents in Delhi-NCR (suo motu)
matters.issue: Suo motu case on women's safety after recent rapes in Delhi-NCR: safety audits, patrolling, CCTV and lighting.
matters.parties: In Re: Recent Rape Incidents in Delhi NCR
matters.date_text: Compliance due in 4 weeks; next date not reported

last_hearing.outcome: Safety audits, patrolling and CCTV/lighting reviews ordered within 4 weeks.

matters.title: Cap on medicine MRPs
matters.issue: Whether the MRP of medicines should be capped at 16% above the retailer's price.
matters.parties: Kishan Chand Jain v EMRB; Dr Sanjay Kulshrestha v Union of India
matters.date_text: Next date not reported

last_hearing.outcome: Court asked why MRP should not be capped at 16% above the retailer's price.

matters.note: Centre separately agreed to cap cancer-drug margins at 30% (12 Oct).

matters.title: Firecracker restrictions (Diwali)
matters.issue: Regulating firecrackers in Delhi-NCR: no total ban or round-the-clock use; permitted types and time windows.
matters.parties: Arjun Gopal v Union of India

last_hearing.outcome: Court ruled out both a total ban and 24-hour use; considering timed use of specified crackers.

matters.note: Outcome of 15 Oct hearing not yet reported.

matters.title: Front-of-pack food labelling
matters.issue: Whether FSSAI must bring in front-of-pack warning labels on packaged food, and on what timeline.
matters.parties: 3S and Our Health Society v Union of India
matters.date_text: Order reserved

last_hearing.outcome: Order reserved after questioning FSSAI's timeline (MA 1177/2025).

matters.title: Trinamool Congress symbol dispute
matters.issue: Dispute over the Trinamool Congress party name and symbol before the Election Commission.
matters.parties: Mamata Banerjee v Election Commission of India
matters.date_text: Affidavits due in 4 weeks; ECI to decide in 3 months

last_hearing.outcome: Parties to file affidavits in 4 weeks; ECI to decide within 3 months.

matters.title: Patent term where grant was delayed
matters.issue: Whether a patent's 20-year term should run from the date of grant when the Patent Office delayed deciding the application (s.53 Patents Act).
matters.parties: Gunjan Sinha v Union of India
matters.date_text: Notice issued; next date not reported

last_hearing.outcome: Notice issued.

matters.title: Mandatory attendance for law students
matters.issue: Whether law colleges can bar students short of attendance from exams, after the Delhi High Court held they cannot.
matters.parties: Bar Council of India v Union of India
matters.date_text: Judgment reserved on 6 Oct 2026

last_hearing.outcome: Judgment reserved.

matters.date_text: Next date not reported

last_hearing.outcome: Court rebuked NCPCR; its Chairperson and Director to be present on the next date.

matters.title: CAPF deputation — contempt
matters.issue: Contempt over non-compliance with the judgment on deputation posts in the Central Armed Police Forces.
matters.parties: Mahendra Singh Deo v Govind Mohan

last_hearing.outcome: "Stark" non-compliance with the Sanjay Prakash (2025) cadre-review directions; Centre to produce files on action taken under the 23 May 2025 order.

matters.title: Commercial courts — pendency and infrastructure
matters.issue: Time-bound implementation of the Commercial Courts Act, 2015: pending commercial cases, too few commercial courts and benches, and infrastructure gaps across States.
matters.parties: Indian Commercial and Arbitration Bar Association v Union of India

last_hearing.outcome: Updated nationwide data sought; Patna HC given two weeks; notices to the AP, Gujarat, Odisha, Telangana and Tripura High Courts, which had not responded.

matters.title: Pecuniary jurisdiction of consumer commissions
matters.issue: Anomalies in fixing consumer-forum jurisdiction by the price paid rather than compensation claimed, and the 2021 cut in the NCDRC's limit from ₹10 crore to ₹2 crore.
matters.parties: M/s Avon Elastomers (India) v M/s Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Co. Ltd. & Ors.
matters.date_text: Was listed 8 Oct 2026; next date not yet reported

last_hearing.outcome: Union given six weeks to file an affidavit on the anomalies and explain the 30 Dec 2021 notification.

matters.note: Outcome of 8 Oct hearing not yet reported.

matters.title: Krishna Janmabhoomi – Shahi Idgah (Mathura)
matters.issue: Appeal against the Allahabad HC order letting the suit no. 17 plaintiffs sue on behalf of all devotees; the Court has indicated a remand as notice did not go to all plaintiffs.
matters.parties: Bhagwan Shrikrishna Virajman & Ors. v Anjuman Islamia, Committee of Shahi Masjid Idgah & Ors.

last_hearing.outcome: Court called the matter "jinxed" after repeated adjournments; said it will hear merits; adjourned for paucity of time.

matters.note: In July 2026 the parties rejected the Court's proposal to mediate the Mathura, Gyanvapi and Sambhal disputes.
